content: All the powers in the universe are already ours. It is we who have put our hands before our eyes and cry that it is dark.
author: Swami Vivekananda
sourceWork: Speeches and Writings of Swami Vivekananda
explanation:
Vivekananda articulates the foundational truth of non-dual Vedanta: you are not a frail, helpless fragment begging the cosmos for strength. You are an intrinsic expression of the infinite consciousness that sustains reality. The feelings of inadequacy, victimhood, and despair are self-imposed blindfolds created by dwelling on temporary limitations and societal conditioning.

The light has never departed; we have simply covered our eyes with our own fears. The moment you remove your hands, the innate radiance of your being is instantly restored.
practicalInsight: Whenever you catch yourself complaining about a lack of resources or capability, ask yourself what latent strength you are choosing to ignore out of habit.
reflectionPrompt: What limiting belief about your own capacity are you maintaining solely because it feels familiar and safe?
